title: Dad: the new toy everywhere
kaylee: The mint vinyl-toy Dad from the lab is now Dad in every Thailand scene: at the house, on every trip, at the barber and on the plane.
questions: At the barber, his own hair stays on until she cuts it short, then it's the strands on his bald head. Does that feel right?
Can the old code-built Dad leave the character lab ("Dad: the old toy")? Yes or keep.
